title: SQL injection in the IBAN field
expected: Reject before any storage or query. A validator must never interpolate a raw IBAN into SQL; use parameterised queries.

title: Shell metacharacters in the IBAN field
expected: Reject on structure (non-alphanumeric) and never pass the value to a shell.

title: Template expression in the IBAN field
expected: Reject on structure. Do not render untrusted input through a template engine that evaluates expressions.

title: Log forging via newline
expected: Reject control characters; escape newlines before logging.

title: Null byte truncation
expected: Reject control characters; do not truncate at the null byte.

title: Cyrillic homoglyph in the country code
expected: Reject: the country code must be ASCII A-Z. Normalise or reject, never silently map.

title: Oversized IBAN
expected: Reject on the country length rule before running MOD-97.

title: Full-width digits in the BBAN
expected: Reject: only ASCII digits are valid.

title: Human-printed grouping treated as valid input
expected: Either reject the spaced form, or strip it once and re-validate against the canonical unspaced value — never let one layer strip while another compares raw.

title: Lower-case IBAN accepted by case folding
expected: Reject lower case, or upper-case exactly once at the boundary and use that canonical form everywhere downstream.
